title: Q-ULTRA-value-2: Verified deploys per unit of cost and human touch (k) out of bounds: restructure: remove what keeps deploys from shipping
body:

**Trigger:** essential variable `value` out of bounds (reading 0.0; limits 1.0 to None)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --check
**Status:** closed

ULTRASTABILITY-1 second-order step: restructure: remove what keeps deploys from shipping. Below the floor the system ships less than it costs to run, so the work stops compounding.

size: M

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-24T16:11:33Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-24T17:12:14Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github.
